description: Extract duplicated normalization logic into one exported helper without changing any observable behavior.
prompt: src/format.js has the same normalization logic copy-pasted into `titleCase` and `sentenceCase` (lowercase, trim, collapse runs of whitespace to a single space). Refactor it: add a `normalize(text)` function, export it alongside the other two, and make both existing functions use it. Observable behavior of `titleCase` and `sentenceCase` must not change, and the existing tests must keep passing.
